profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead building AI & ML systems
profile.jobTitle: Team Lead Senior Software Engineer (AI & ML, Full Stack)
profile.summary:
I’m a Senior Software Engineer Team Lead with a background in full-stack engineering, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, product development, and art.
 
At DealerOn, I’ve helped lead the research, architecture, development, and production delivery of Sidekick, an enterprise AI & ML suite spanning multimedia, chat, insights, compliance, and marketing. My work has included agentic AI, computer vision, multimodal analysis, generative media, model training and fine-tuning, evaluation, observability, orchestration, MLOps/LLMOps, and deployment in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.
 
In addition to specializing in AI / ML, I’ve built production software across .NET, C#, Vue, Angular, SQL, and Azure. I’ve also built and launched independent products across web, mobile, AR, and multimedia, expanding my experience across software engineering, product architecture, company building, and go-to-market execution.
 
I’m especially interested in applied AI, machine learning, computer vision, generative systems, agentic workflows, and turning ambitious ideas into practical, scalable products.

Outside of engineering, I’m also an artist with experience creating and selling original work, including personal and professional pieces and murals.

Website: https://ericgiddings.com

positions.title: Team Lead Senior Software Engineer (AI & ML, Full Stack)
positions.description:
Helping lead the research, architecture, development, and production delivery of DealerOn’s Sidekick enterprise Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning suite, building greenfield systems across agentic AI, computer vision, generative media, orchestration, and model deployment under aggressive timelines for the automotive industry. Sidekick supports multiple product areas across DealerOn’s platform, including multimedia, chat, insights, compliance, and marketing. Previously worked as a full-stack engineer on core CMS systems using .NET, Vue, SQL, and Azure.

- Helping ship multiple production AI/ML systems for DealerOn’s Sidekick suite within a rapid, high-stakes R&D cycle.
- Building agentic and multi-system AI workflows, including tool-enabled LLM agents, MCP-based integrations, context handling, evaluation pipelines, harness design, multimodal document analysis, and agentic web workflows.
- Working across applied AI domains including conversational systems, agentic workflows, computer vision, multimodal analysis, image quality analysis, classification, segmentation, object detection, image generation, video generation, upscaling, text-to-speech, and more.
- Training, fine-tuning, and deploying custom models using PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face tooling, transfer learning techniques, and Azure Machine Learning.
- Helping manage MLOps and LLMOps practices across the Sidekick suite, supporting model and LLM evaluation, observability, deployment, reliability, and production operations.
- Designing durable and fault-tolerant AI workflows with attention to reliability, cost control, and scalable production execution.
- Helping drive internal AI adoption, including GitHub Copilot enablement, mentorship, company-wide knowledge sharing, and contributing to standards around AI/ML implementation practices.

positions.title: Founder | Full-Stack Engineer | AI/ML | Artist
positions.description:
Built and launched independent software products across web, mobile, AR, and multimedia. This work strengthened my experience across full-stack engineering, product architecture, machine learning, augmented reality, company building, and go-to-market execution, including SEO, outreach, and product growth. Projects include Hollergrams, an AI/ML and AR-based messaging platform; TRAGOA, an Africa-focused B2B marketplace; AR World Tour, an AR experience platform for tourism; and AbraColabra, a real-time multimedia collaboration website. My independent work also includes personal and professional art, design, and murals.

Project showcase: ericgiddings.com/websitesapps
